messages.content:
Please help me with a shopping and smart-home task for user_01. I want to buy 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5, product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, in the audio category, but first check popular alternatives in audio and recommend the best option for quantity 1. Then scan my living_room devices, check the status of the living room light for area living_room, prepare any restart request needed for device_id light_living, get its current light state, and apply a scene with brightness 70.

After that, create an invoice for item p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, using paypal and send it to alice@company.com. Then check my available coupons, use coupon_code SAVE15 if it’s the best discount, and generate the final invoice with the optimized discounted amount. Finally, save a note titled Shopping and Light Automation Summary with the content “Selected product invoiced successfully and smart light scene applied.” and tags shopping, iot, invoice, then send an app alert with medium priority saying: “Your purchase workflow and smart-light update are complete.”
